title: The Lantern Fox
synopsis: At the autumn festival, shy Mira loses track of her little brother Kenji. A paper lantern she won at a stall unfolds into a fox spirit named Hoshi. Together they follow a trail of ember-lights through the sleeping town and find Kenji asleep under the shrine tree before dawn.
story_text: Mira gripped the paper lantern with both hands... (full prose omitted in fixture; real productions carry the complete refined story here).

beats.summary: Festival night; Mira wins a fox-faced paper lantern; Kenji vanishes in the crowd.
The lantern unfolds into Hoshi the fox spirit; it offers a bargain: follow, and do not let the flame go out.
Ember-lights lead them to the shrine tree; Kenji is asleep beneath it; Hoshi returns to paper at dawn.
